name: Plaid CTF
description: Organized by the Plaid Parliament of Pwning (PPP), one of the world's top CTF teams. One of the most prestigious CTF competitions.

peerReview.processDescription: Challenges designed by PPP members and guest contributors. Jeopardy format: web, crypto, reversing, pwn, misc. Past challenges discussed and analyzed in CTF community.

attribution.attributionNotes: One of most prestigious CTF competitions. Winning teams gain significant industry recognition.
